conceptZh: 獨角毛怪和飛碟裡的小外星人搶拉同一條泡棉帶，雙雙摔了個屁股墩，彈開的泡棉片剛好拼成「隊」。
object: One folded cobalt foam strap made of spring-loaded stroke pieces, with a chunky grip at each end.
morph: The two grips spring open and seat flush as the left 阝, while the wider middle pieces fan out into the right-side 㒸. The pieces settle into the exact silhouette of 隊.
creativeAngle: 用怪獸一轉身就把泡棉帶甩進飛碟光束的失誤引發拔河，最後讓兩個對手隔著「隊」同步敬禮，演出「戰隊」。
promptEn:
Create an 8-second stylized 3D cartoon in one locked, straight-on wide shot. On a pale apricot stage, a huge round tangerine monster with shaggy fur, one soft horn and a goofy grin guards a folded cobalt foam strap. At the opposite edge, a tiny green cartoon alien rides an original toy flying saucer with an open seat. Leave the middle of the frame open for 隊, with room for the two characters to land at the sides.

0.0–1.6 s. The monster hugs the strap proudly and turns its whole round body to show it off. The loose end swings into the saucer’s little tractor beam, and the alien grabs it with both hands. The monster sees the strap sliding away, lunges to grab its own end and plants both heels.

1.6–3.4 s. The first spoken 「隊」 lands as the first tug fans the folded middle into distinct cobalt pieces, beginning the build in plain view. The monster leans farther back, cheeks turning red and heels skidding inward, while the alien braces both feet against the saucer rim and pulls until the saucer tips toward center. The strap stretches taut and both freeze for a split beat.

3.4–4.9 s. The strap pops free from both sets of hands. The monster flies left and lands on its rump as the alien flops backward onto the padded saucer seat, both hits landing on one soft comic BONK. The released foam recoils toward center on that same beat. The slim end pieces fold together into the left 阝, and the wider middle pieces fan into the right 㒸, with its two top marks and long lower sweeps clearly distinct. Use a standard upright Taiwanese Traditional Chinese print glyph as the exact final silhouette so every stroke lands in its proper place. The second spoken 「隊」 lands on the final snap into alignment.

4.9–8.0 s. Hold the solid cobalt 隊 perfectly still, centered, uncropped and about 70% of frame height with clear margins. Around 6.0 s, the monster catches the alien’s eye and they give a crisp synchronized salute exactly as 「戰隊」 is spoken. The monster’s horn wobbles and its grin spreads. Keep both performers outside the strokes.

A warm off-screen voice speaks slowly and distinctly in clear Taiwanese Mandarin, reading exactly these syllables and tones with a short pause between utterances: 「隊、隊、戰隊」 (ㄉㄨㄟˋ、ㄉㄨㄟˋ、ㄓㄢˋ ㄉㄨㄟˋ). Stop after 戰隊. Keep the bonk quiet under the voice. The single glyph 隊 is the only on-screen text. Use soft, even lighting and a clean background free of watermarks and flashing effects.
